cohort: The participants were fetal lambs, with some assigned to a congenital diaphragmatic hernia (DH) group and others serving as normal controls.
finding: Fetal lambs with induced congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) exhibited significantly reduced total lung volume, total lung area, and bronchial area compared to controls, and strong correlations were found between total lung volume, total lung area, and bronchial area in both groups.
gest_age: DH created at 75 days gestation; lambs delivered and killed at term
